name: Feeling Lucky
detailed_description:
You could have sworn this little store wasn’t here before, and yet it looks like it’s older than you. It’s the brightest place in the darkest part of town. And the scratch cards here are really addictive. While it’s a small town, you’re surprised that more people aren’t in here.

A mini point and click experience where you purchase and play a variety of unusual and increasingly expensive scratch cards, produced by a corporate giant that you’ve never heard of called “Chaos Fortuna”. 

Each card has a different mixture of strategy and luck, and while these scratch cards are printed on standard paper (seemingly a few decades ago), the way you interact with them affects the rewards you can redeem.

There’s a whole range of cards available. Some cards seem to be free, others, downright dangerous. Perhaps you should read the small print very carefully. There's definitely something going on here. 

Key Features:

  • 20 scratch cards to master, each with a unique mix of strategy and luck

  • A mini point and click style environment

  • Persistent currency and progression

  • Subtle narrative cues, and a strange sensation that something isn’t quite right

How much treasure do you dare to acrew?
